groups.purpose: All 30 canonical records and run order; worker-throughput curve
groups.limitations: Three repetitions; CPU/window and sampled-peak caveats. Environment capture lacks a standalone dataset digest.
groups.omitted: Binaries and all Phase 7 observations omitted; C and Phase 6C provide selected topology evidence.

groups.purpose: All 30 canonical records, gates, metadata, scoped worker identity
groups.limitations: Canonical resident P=8; identity diagnostics P=4. Default heavy observer insufficient. Source residency snapshots are not sustained cold I/O.
groups.omitted: Binaries, global before/after ps, redundant PID files, generated race-preflight source; no dataset.

groups.purpose: All 36 throughput/latency records, including bounded blocking
groups.limitations: Throughput and latency are separate experiments. Do not compare earlier queue-exclusive service tails as application tails.
groups.omitted: No source or additional files in this selected archive.

groups.purpose: All six throughput/latency records; enter-frequency falsification
groups.limitations: Historical sequential comparison to Phase 2, not randomized concurrent comparison.

groups.purpose: Complete 33-run invalid control, not a valid worker-count curve
groups.limitations: Bounded setting did not control relevant population; no post-set verification; old observer wrong process.
groups.omitted: Binaries and invalid worker observations omitted; invalidity documented, not hidden.

groups.limitations: One canonical run per condition, host-specific account behavior.
groups.omitted: Three tiny unknown-revision gate results, binaries and observations omitted.

groups.limitations: Historical wait-TID instrumentation invalid. Hot-path gettid perturbs performance.
groups.omitted: Old observers/binaries omitted in favor of later topology below.

groups.purpose: Later two scoped lock/unlock identity observations
groups.limitations: Original summary parser has empty enter sets/false correlations. Derived topology reads result.json directly. Wait field remains invalid. Archive name does not mean complete matrix.
groups.omitted: Global ps, binaries and redundant PID files omitted.

groups.purpose: Test portability and race-prerequisite failure evidence
groups.limitations: Gate failures, not benchmark results. Singleton batches were valid; missing race prerequisites were tooling.

groups.execution_revision: As recorded in probe; do not infer a missing execution SHA
groups.limitations: Security failure, not an io_uring performance result.
groups.omitted: Unrelated blocking results and later host probe omitted.

groups.purpose: Final same-revision bounded-blocking and attempted perf controls, not a new general phase
groups.limitations: No current client latency; sampled peaks; nonresident-start; kernel frames unresolved despite matching vmlinux
groups.omitted: Binaries, raw perf.data, full system-wide reports, global process snapshots, unrelated disk/cgroup inventory
